semantic_filter: Molecule appears in the molecule label table, which lists the labeled molecules.
aggregation_semantics: One value per molecule; the grain is the individual labeled molecule.
grain: one row per labeled molecule (343 rows)
validation: Primary key of the label table. 343 distinct values, no duplicates, range TR000 to TR501.

semantic_filter: Molecule owns at least one atom.
aggregation_semantics: Molecule reference repeated once per atom row.
grain: one value per atom row; 444 distinct molecules
validation: All values are well-formed molecule identifiers; every labeled molecule has atoms.

semantic_filter: Molecule owns at least one bond.
aggregation_semantics: Molecule reference repeated once per bond row.
grain: one value per bond row; 444 distinct molecules
validation: Matches the molecule set of the atom table exactly; every labeled molecule has bonds.

aggregation_semantics: One value per atom; no aggregation.
validation: Primary key. Every identifier begins with its molecule identifier followed by an underscore; 0 mismatches.

aggregation_semantics: Element symbol per atom; counts group atoms by symbol.
One value per bond; no aggregation.
validation: Primary key. Every identifier starts with its molecule identifier; every bond also appears in the incidence table.

aggregation_semantics: One bond type per bond; distributions count bonds by type.
One label per molecule; distributions count molecules by label.

semantic_filter: Label value denotes a carcinogenic molecule (the '+' value).
aggregation_semantics: Molecule count; the rows selected are the carcinogenic molecules.
grain: one row per carcinogenic molecule (152 rows)
validation: Count verified against the label distribution.

semantic_filter: Label value denotes a non-carcinogenic molecule (the '-' value).
aggregation_semantics: Molecule count; the rows selected are the non-carcinogenic molecules.
grain: one row per non-carcinogenic molecule (191 rows)
validation: Count verified against the label distribution.

aggregation_semantics: Distinct bonds per atom are counted from distinct bond identifiers; each bond contributes exactly two rows.
grain: one row per directed bond-to-atom pair (24,758 rows for 12,379 bonds)
validation: Every bond has exactly 2 rows; no duplicate (atom, counterpart, bond) triples; every referenced atom and bond exists.

aggregation_semantics: Count of atoms grouped by molecule and element symbol.
validation: Summing the counts for a molecule reproduces its atom count.

aggregation_semantics: Count of distinct bonds per atom; atoms absent from the incidence table have zero.
validation: Maximum observed value 4; 49 atoms have no incidence rows.

semantic_filter: Optionally restricted to atoms whose molecule carries a given carcinogenicity label.
aggregation_semantics: Count of distinct atom identifiers grouped by element symbol over a molecule population.
grain: one count per element per population
validation: Element totals sum to the atom count of the population.

aggregation_semantics: A molecule-element pair is present when at least one atom row exists for that pair.
grain: one presence flag per molecule-element pair
validation: Every labeled molecule has at least one atom row; 4 molecules contain fluorine overall.

semantic_filter: Population restricted to molecules that carry a label.
aggregation_semantics: Count of '+' labels divided by the count of labeled molecules, multiplied by 100.
validation: 152 of 343 labeled molecules; no null labels.

semantic_filter: Population restricted to molecules of the requested carcinogenicity status or to a single molecule.
aggregation_semantics: Count of atoms of the element divided by the chosen population size, multiplied by 100; the denominator may be the population's atom count or its molecule count.
grain: one percentage per element per population
validation: Element counts verified per label group (for example 116 chlorine atoms in carcinogenic molecules among 2,880 atoms).

semantic_filter: Population may be restricted to bonds whose molecule carries a given carcinogenicity label.
aggregation_semantics: Count of bonds of the type divided by the relevant bond population, multiplied by 100.
grain: one percentage per bond type per population
validation: Cross-tab of bond type by label verified: single '+' 3,078 and '-' 4,665; double '+' 634 and '-' 774; triple '+' 3 and '-' 2.
